risk: Orphaned Content Modifier (CallActivity_86) and Groovy Script (CallActivity_77)
consequence: The order code validity check and XPath extraction configured in CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 are detached from the active BPMN sequence flow. Invalid order codes bypass validation and route directly to EscalationEndEvent or downstream systems.
mitigation: Unit tests TC_SOAP_ROUTING_ESCALATION_DEFAULT verify that invalid order types fall into the default escalation path; recommended to connect CallActivity_77 before ExclusiveGateway_80.

risk: Sensitive Data Leakage via Error Subprocess Logging (Log_Payload.gsh)
consequence: In the event of parsing/mapping failures, CallActivity_97 reads ${property.InputPayload} and CallActivity_100 stores the full raw message payload into MPL attachments, exposing PII or confidential sales pricing in production logs.
mitigation: Test case TC_SOAP_MAPPING_EXCEPTION_SUBPROCESS captures MPL attachment payloads; implement payload masking before logging in Log_Payload.gsh.

mitigation: Automated pytest simulation covers connection timeouts and asserts proper failure escalation handling without silent failure.

mitigation: Pytest engine executes parameterized routing validation ensuring deterministic fallback to EscalationEndEvent 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.
